category.label: Financial Scams
category.description: Major alleged and proven financial frauds and financial scandals in India. amount_original is expressed in INR crore (₹ crore), unless null. Figures may represent different measures (fraud alleged, notional loss, funds raised, debt/default, or investor claims) and must not be added or compared as if they were equivalent. The original visual benchmark is India's annual Union Health Budget (FY 2024–25).

items.name: Coal Block Allocation Scam
items.accused: Multiple industrialists and government officials
items.amount_label: CAG's notional loss estimate associated with coal-block allocation
items.amount_caveat: ₹1,85,591 crore is the widely cited CAG notional-loss estimate, not money proven stolen or a realised fiscal loss. The methodology and assumptions were contested; the Supreme Court cancelled 214 coal-block allocations in 2014. Criminal cases have had different outcomes and should not be treated as one single proceeding.

items.name: 2G Spectrum Scam
items.accused: A. Raja (former Telecom Minister), telecom companies
items.amount_label: CAG's notional estimate of potential revenue foregone
items.amount_caveat: ₹1.76 lakh crore was a notional estimate of potential revenue foregone, not a finding that this amount was stolen. The special CBI court acquitted all accused in December 2017. The acquittal was challenged on appeal; do not state that the Supreme Court upheld it in 2023.

items.name: IL&FS Group Collapse
items.accused: IL&FS board (Ravi Parthasarathy and others), credit rating agencies
items.amount_label: Total group debt across 348 entities at time of default
items.amount_caveat: Actual unpaid debt, not a notional estimate. Triggered a liquidity crisis across India's NBFC sector. SFIO investigation ongoing; partial debt recovery underway through NCLT-supervised asset sales.

items.name: Commonwealth Games Scam
items.accused: Suresh Kalmadi (Organising Committee Chairman) and others
items.amount_label: No defensible single aggregate scam-loss figure established
items.amount_caveat: The often-repeated ₹70,000 crore figure is not supported as a single CAG-estimated loss by the cited CAG report. CAG and the Shunglu Committee identified numerous irregularities, overpricing, procedural lapses and specific financial implications, but these should be recorded case-by-case rather than collapsed into ₹70,000 crore of proven loss.
items.source_label: CAG Report No. 6 of 2011; individual audit findings

items.name: Harshad Mehta Securities Scam
items.accused: Harshad Mehta (stockbroker), multiple bank officials
items.amount_label: JPC-reported amount commonly cited for the 1992 securities scam
items.amount_caveat: The often-cited ₹4,025 crore is a historical nominal estimate associated with the JPC report; it is not directly comparable to later rupee amounts without inflation adjustment. Avoid describing every related criminal case as having the same disposition.

items.name: ABG Shipyard Bank Fraud
items.accused: Rishi Kamlesh Agarwal (CMD, ABG Shipyard Ltd)
items.amount_label: Amount in CBI FIR — largest single bank fraud case filed in India
items.amount_caveat: Alleged fraud on a consortium of 28 banks between 2012 and 2017, flagged by SBI in 2019. CBI registered FIR in February 2022. Investigation and asset recovery ongoing; no conviction yet.

items.name: PNB – Nirav Modi Fraud
items.accused: Nirav Modi, Mehul Choksi, PNB bank officials
items.amount_label: Amount in CBI and ED chargesheets
items.amount_caveat: Headline amount of roughly ₹13,000–13,500 crore across related PNB fraud allegations. This is an alleged bank-fraud exposure, not a final net-loss calculation. Nirav Modi's UK extradition litigation and Indian criminal proceedings are distinct; do not label the whole Indian case 'convicted' solely because of UK proceedings.
items.source_label: UK High Court extradition judgment, 25 March 2026

items.name: Vijay Mallya – Kingfisher Airlines Default
items.accused: Vijay Mallya (Chairman, United Breweries / Kingfisher Airlines)
items.amount_label: Outstanding loans owed to consortium of 17 banks, declared wilful default
items.amount_caveat: Debt accumulated over 2010–2016. Mallya left India in March 2016. UK courts ordered extradition in 2021; Mallya pursuing legal challenges. ED has recovered assets worth over ₹14,000 crore through PMLA proceedings — exceeding the original loan.

items.name: Satyam Accounting Scandal
items.accused: B. Ramalinga Raju (Founder and Chairman, Satyam Computer Services)
items.amount_label: Amount admitted by Raju in his resignation-confession letter to the Board
items.amount_caveat: ₹7,136 crore is the approximate amount of inflated/fictitious cash balances and other accounting misstatements admitted in Ramalinga Raju's 2009 letter; it is not necessarily the final investor loss. The criminal and regulatory proceedings have had different outcomes and appeals; verify the latest status before presenting a single case-status label.

items.name: Bihar Fodder Scam
items.accused: Officials of Bihar's Animal Husbandry Department and others
items.amount_label: Widely reported aggregate value of fraudulent treasury withdrawals
items.amount_caveat: The approximately ₹950 crore figure is a commonly reported aggregate across multiple cases and years. It concerns fraudulent withdrawals against fabricated bills; individual cases and convictions have separate amounts and outcomes.
items.source_label: CBI case records; reported aggregate estimate

items.name: Ketan Parekh Stock-Market Manipulation
items.accused: Ketan Parekh and associated entities
items.amount_label: SEBI order identified ₹351 crore in financing to connected entities
items.amount_caveat: ₹351 crore is a specific financing amount identified in SEBI material, not a total estimate of investor losses or the entire manipulation. The episode involved circular/synchronised trades and artificial volumes in selected shares.

items.name: Abdul Karim Telgi Fake Stamp-Paper Scam
items.accused: Abdul Karim Telgi and associates
items.amount_label: Reported CBI internal estimate of the racket's value
items.amount_caveat: The ₹30,000 crore figure often repeated in early coverage was an unverified initial estimate. A 2007 report citing a CBI internal bulletin gave ₹171.33 crore; this is a reported estimate, not a definitive audited national loss figure.
items.source_label: Times of India report citing CBI internal bulletin

items.name: Saradha Group Chit-Fund Scam
items.accused: Saradha Group promoters and associated persons
items.amount_label: Commonly reported estimate of investor funds affected
items.amount_caveat: Approximately ₹2,500 crore is a widely reported estimate, not a single final judicial finding of net loss. Keep the amount distinct from funds collected, seized assets and eventual investor recoveries.

items.name: Rose Valley Investment Scam
items.accused: Rose Valley Group promoters and associated persons
items.amount_label: ED-identified proceeds of crime remaining unpaid to investors
items.amount_caveat: The ED reported that the group collected ₹17,520 crore and identified ₹6,666 crore as proceeds of crime remaining unpaid to investors. Use ₹6,666 crore for this specific measure; do not confuse it with total collections or add the two figures.
items.source_label: Press Information Bureau summarising ED investigation, 2025

items.name: PACL / Pearls Investment Scheme
items.accused: PACL Ltd and associated promoters
items.amount_label: Widely reported amount collected from investors and subject to refund proceedings
items.amount_caveat: The figure is associated with the scale of investor collections/refund liability in SEBI and Supreme Court proceedings, not a final net-loss finding. Refunds are ongoing and only part of the amount has been disbursed.

items.name: Sahara OFCD Fundraising Case
items.accused: Sahara India Real Estate Corporation Ltd, Sahara Housing Investment Corporation Ltd and associated persons
items.amount_label: Amount reported in the Sahara-SEBI Refund Account
items.amount_caveat: ₹24,979.67 crore is the amount lying in the Sahara-SEBI Refund Account as cited in government updates, not a proven amount stolen or the exact total of every Sahara fundraising scheme. Keep OFCD proceedings separate from Sahara cooperative-society deposit refund arrangements.
items.source_label: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Cooperation

items.name: National Spot Exchange (NSEL) Payment Crisis
items.accused: Defaulting trading members and other persons under investigation
items.amount_label: Outstanding payment obligations after the 2013 settlement crisis
items.amount_caveat: Approximately ₹5,600 crore in payment obligations were defaulted on by trading members. The amount was owed by counterparties/borrowers; it should not be described as money received or stolen by NSEL itself. Recovery proceedings have been separate.
items.source_label: SEBI order discussing NSEL payment crisis

items.name: Rotomac Bank-Fraud Case
items.accused: Vikram Kothari, family members and others
items.amount_label: CBI-reported alleged loan fraud/default across seven banks
items.amount_caveat: Approximately ₹3,695 crore was the alleged aggregate exposure/default cited when the CBI registered its case. It is not a final net-loss or recovery figure; the first chargesheet covered one bank's portion of the total.

items.name: DHFL Bank-Fraud Case
items.accused: DHFL promoters and other accused persons
items.amount_label: Amount alleged in the CBI case involving a consortium of banks
items.amount_caveat: ₹34,615 crore is the alleged fraud amount in the CBI case, not a final adjudicated loss. Keep this distinct from total debt, insolvency claims, recoveries and separate money-laundering proceedings.
items.source_label: CBI case registered in 2022; verify latest court status

items.name: Sterling Biotech / Sandesara Group Bank Fraud
items.accused: Sterling Biotech promoters/directors and associated persons
items.amount_label: ED-reported estimated fraud amount
items.amount_caveat: The ED's 2025–26 annual report describes the estimated fraud as about ₹14,690.95 crore and also reports substantial recovery/restitution. This is a case estimate; do not treat it as the unrecovered balance.

items.name: NSE Co-location / Market-Access Controversy
items.accused: NSE officials, brokers and other entities named in regulatory proceedings
items.amount_label: No single verified aggregate investor-loss figure
items.amount_caveat: Regulatory proceedings concerned alleged preferential access and market-system violations. SEBI has issued multiple orders over time; penalties or disgorgement in individual orders are not a single scam-loss total.

items.name: Devas–Antrix Satellite Deal Controversy
items.accused: Devas Multimedia and former Antrix/ISRO officials named in proceedings
items.amount_label: Investment inflow cited in Indian company-law proceedings
items.amount_caveat: ₹579 crore is an investment inflow discussed in tribunal/court proceedings, not a measure of the full arbitration liability or a single proven public loss. The dispute includes fraud findings in Indian company-law proceedings and separate international arbitration/enforcement cases.
items.source_label: Supreme Court judgment discussing NCLT findings in Devas matter

items.name: Adarsh Cooperative Housing Society Controversy
items.accused: Society members, public officials and others named in investigations
items.amount_label: No single comparable scam amount established
items.amount_caveat: The CAG documented serious irregularities involving public land, approvals and preferential allotments. A property valuation or land value should not be presented as cash stolen or a proven financial loss.
